label: Kyiv
sub: Capital of Ukraine; survived Russian siege Feb-March 2022

label: Kharkiv
sub: Ukraine's 2nd largest city; survived multiple Russian offensives; counteroffensive liberated 8,000 sq km (Sept 2022)

label: Mariupol
sub: Besieged and destroyed by Russia (Feb-May 2022); Azovstal defenders surrendered May 16-20, 2022

label: Simferopol (Crimea)
sub: Capital of Crimea; illegally annexed by Russia March 2014; internationally recognized as Ukrainian territory

label: Donetsk
sub: Occupied by Russia-backed forces since April 2014; illegally annexed September 2022; Ukrainian government in exile in Kramatorsk

label: Zaporizhzhia
sub: Frontline city; oblast illegally annexed by Russia (Sept 2022) but city remains under Ukrainian control; near ZNPP

label: Kherson
sub: Liberated by Ukraine November 11, 2022; first occupied regional capital retaken; under constant Russian shelling from left bank

label: Chernobyl
sub: Site of 1986 nuclear disaster; Russian forces occupied briefly Feb-March 2022; 30km exclusion zone remains. June 7, 2026: Russian Shahed drone struck the spent nuclear fuel storage building — IAEA emergency site visit ordered; no radiation release

label: Lviv
sub: Cultural capital of western Ukraine; major transit hub for Western military aid; historically part of Habsburg Austria and interwar Poland

label: Odesa
sub: Major Black Sea port; survived Russian naval bombardment; key to Ukrainian grain exports under the Black Sea Grain Initiative

label: Bakhmut
sub: Site of the longest and bloodiest battle of the war (July 2022 – May 2023); captured by Wagner Group; city largely destroyed

label: Avdiivka
sub: Strategically fortified Ukrainian stronghold; held since 2014; fell to Russia February 17, 2024

label: Bucha
sub: Site of mass atrocities by Russian forces; 400+ civilians found killed after Russian withdrawal March 2022; ICC war crimes investigation

label: Hostomel Airport
sub: Site of failed Russian VDV assault Feb 24, 2022; Russian paratroopers repelled in defense of Kyiv's northern approach

label: Irpin
sub: Kyiv suburb; evacuations under fire became iconic images of early war; liberated by Ukraine March 28, 2022

label: Babi Yar
sub: Site of Holocaust massacre: 33,771 Jews killed Sept 29-30, 1941 by Nazi SS Einsatzgruppen; now a memorial site in Kyiv

label: Kerch Bridge
sub: Bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea; completed 2018; partially destroyed Oct 8, 2022 and July 2023 in Ukrainian attacks

label: Zaporizhzhia NPP
sub: Europe's largest nuclear power plant; seized by Russia March 4, 2022; used as military base; IAEA monitoring since Sept 2022; drone strike killed a worker on Apr 27, 2026

label: Kramatorsk
sub: Administrative center of Ukrainian-held Donetsk Oblast; Kramatorsk railway station strike killed 59 civilians April 8, 2022

label: Izium
sub: Key Russian logistics hub; liberated by Ukraine in Kharkiv counteroffensive (Sept 2022); mass graves with evidence of torture found

label: Poltava
sub: Site of the 1709 Battle of Poltava where Peter the Great defeated Hetman Mazepa and Swedish King Charles XII, ending the Cossack bid for independence

label: Kakhovka Dam
sub: Site of catastrophic dam destruction June 6, 2023; flooding killed dozens and caused major ecological damage to the Dnipro delta

label: Melitopol
sub: Occupied by Russia since March 2022; key logistics hub and air base; Ukrainian counteroffensive (2023) targeted Melitopol corridor

label: Berdyansk
sub: Occupied Black Sea port; Ukraine sank Russian landing ship Saratov here March 24, 2022 using TB-2 drone

label: Dnipro
sub: Ukraine's third largest city; key logistics and industrial hub; site of Russian missile strikes on apartment buildings

label: Mykolaiv
sub: Southern city that repelled Russian advance on Odesa; key to Ukraine holding its Black Sea coastline

label: Chernihiv
sub: Northern city besieged by Russian forces Feb-March 2022; cut off from Kyiv supply lines; liberated after Russian withdrawal

label: Sumy
sub: Northeastern city on Russian border; endured sustained cross-border shelling; launch point for Ukrainian Kursk incursion (Aug 2024)

label: Lyman
sub: Strategic rail hub liberated by Ukraine October 1, 2022 during Kharkiv counteroffensive, the same day Putin announced illegal annexation

label: Khortytsia Island
sub: Island near Zaporizhzhia; historic center of the Zaporozhian Sich Cossack Host; symbol of Ukrainian Cossack identity

label: Pereiaslav
sub: Site of the 1654 Pereiaslav Agreement between Hetman Khmelnytsky and Muscovy Tsar Alexis — the most contested treaty in Ukrainian history

label: Vuhledar
sub: Strategic coal town on southern Donetsk front; Ukrainian defenders destroyed hundreds of Russian armored vehicles in 2022-23

label: Soledar
sub: Salt mine town captured by Wagner Group January 2023; fighting over vast underground mine tunnels used as shelter

label: Uzhhorod
sub: Western gateway city on EU border; major transit point for refugees and Western military aid entering Ukraine

label: Sevastopol
sub: Russian Black Sea Fleet base in occupied Crimea; home port extended to 2042 under Kharkiv Accords (2010); targeted by Ukrainian naval drones in 2023-24

label: Tuapse Refinery
sub: Rosneft oil refinery in Krasnodar Krai, Russia; struck by Ukrainian drones 4 times in Apr-May 2026; processes 12M tons/year; Russia's refinery capacity hit 16-year low after sustained campaign

label: Chornomorsk
sub: Odesa region port city; Russian drone strike on May 3, 2026 destroyed 35 residential buildings, killing 2 civilians

label: Novorossiysk
sub: Russia's primary Black Sea naval/commercial port; Ukrainian drones struck shadow fleet tankers and cruise missile carrier here on May 3, 2026; Russia's main port after Black Sea Fleet relocated from Sevastopol

label: Zaporizhzhia — May 5 Strike
sub: Russian guided aerial bombs killed 12 civilians and wounded 43 on May 5, 2026 — worst single strike on the city in the entire war; car repair workshop and residential buildings destroyed

label: Kramatorsk — May 5 Strike
sub: Russian guided aerial bombs killed 6 and wounded 12 in Kramatorsk on May 5, 2026; last major Ukrainian-held administrative hub in Donetsk Oblast

label: Poltava — Naftogaz Strike
sub: Russian Iskander missiles and drones struck Naftogaz gas production facilities on May 4-5, 2026, killing 5 (including 2 rescuers killed in deliberate double-tap); 107th energy infrastructure strike of 2026

label: Sumy — Kindergarten Strike
sub: Russian missile strike on a kindergarten in Sumy border region on May 7, 2026, killed 2 people. Sumy city declared a day of mourning. Russia conducted the attack during both its own and Ukraine's declared ceasefire periods.

label: Kharkiv — Drone Strike Wounds 9
sub: Russian drone strike on residential Kharkiv on May 7, 2026, wounded 9 people including 3 children, continuing Russia's pattern of civilian targeting during declared ceasefire periods.

label: Stepnohirsk
sub: Settlement in Zaporizhzhia Oblast; Ukraine's Military Intelligence (HUR) claimed full control on May 18, 2026, in the Orikhiv direction — a tactical advance in the Zaporizhzhia south front

label: Odesa — May 18 Mass Strike
sub: Russian drones and missiles struck residential buildings in 2 districts, a kindergarten, a lyceum, and a police station on May 18, 2026; 20 injured including 2 children — part of the 524-drone + 22-missile overnight barrage

label: Snizhne — Russian Drone Training Camp Strike
sub: Ukrainian precision drone strike on May 21, 2026 destroyed a Russian drone pilot training camp, killing 65 cadets and 1 instructor — one of the most significant single strikes against Russian drone training infrastructure in the war

label: Kryvyi Rih — Industrial Facility Strike
sub: Russian drone strike on May 20, 2026 hit an industrial facility in Kryvyi Rih (Dnipropetrovsk region) as part of the overnight 116-drone barrage; Chuhuiv community in Kharkiv region also struck

label: Bila Tserkva — Oreshnik Ballistic Missile Strike
sub: Russia's RS-26 Rubizh 'Oreshnik' hypersonic intermediate-range ballistic missile struck Bila Tserkva (Kyiv Oblast, 50 km south of Kyiv) on May 24, 2026 — the 3rd wartime use of the nuclear-capable weapon; nearly unstoppable at Mach 10-13

label: Sumy — Russian Drone Strikes Funeral Procession
sub: Russian drone struck a funeral procession on the outskirts of Sumy on May 23, 2026 — killing 1 person and injuring 14 others; a potential war crime under international humanitarian law

label: Bilozerka — Hospital Shelled
sub: Russia shelled the hospital in Bilozerka community (Kherson Oblast) on May 25, 2026 — a potential war crime targeting a protected medical facility on the Ukrainian-controlled right bank of the Dnipro River

label: Kyiv — Melnyk Reburial Ceremony
sub: On May 25, 2026, President Zelensky attended the reburial ceremony of Andriy Melnyk (OUN leader) at the National Military Cemetery in Kyiv alongside Ukraine's top leadership — a nationally significant ceremony held amid active Russian bombardment of the capital

label: Taganrog — Ukraine Strike on Port
sub: Ukrainian drones struck Taganrog port (Rostov Oblast) on May 30, 2026 — hitting a tanker, fuel storage tanks, and an administrative building; part of Ukraine's 2026 deep-strike energy campaign ($9.5B+ in Russian losses)

label: Galati, Romania — Russian Drone NATO Territory Incident
sub: Russian Geran-2 drone strayed into NATO territory and crashed into a 10-story apartment in Galati, Romania on May 29, 2026 — injuring 2 people; first drone casualty on Romanian/NATO soil; Romania convened emergency defense council

label: Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi — Maternity Ward Strike
sub: Russian drone struck a maternity ward in Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi (Odesa Oblast) on June 1, 2026 — 6 postpartum women injured; constitutes a potential war crime targeting a protected medical facility under IHL

label: Chornobyl NFS — Drone Strike
sub: Russian Shahed drone struck the spent nuclear fuel storage facility's fuel-reception building on June 7, 2026; structural damage, ~40m² fire; no radiation release; IAEA emergency site visit ordered. Zelensky: 'extremely vile'

label: Feodosia — Oil Terminal Strike
sub: Ukrainian SOF drones struck Feodosia maritime oil terminal in occupied Crimea on June 7, 2026 — 7 storage tanks (10,000–20,000 m³ each) ablaze; terminal supplied Russian forces in Crimea

label: Kerch District — Oil Depot Strike
sub: Ukrainian SOF drones struck Semykolodezyanska oil depot in Kerch district, occupied Crimea on June 7, 2026 — 9 storage tanks (700–3,000 m³) ablaze; part of coordinated Crimea logistics attrition campaign

label: Chonhar Bridge — Damaged
sub: Ukrainian drone strike damaged the Chonhar bridge on June 7, 2026, suspending traffic between occupied Crimea and Russian-controlled Kherson Oblast; Dzhankoi checkpoint closed; key logistics bottleneck interdicted

label: Nikopol/Pokrov — Substation & Gas Station Strike
sub: Russian drone barrage hit a 150kV substation near Pokrov and a gas station in Nikopol on August 6, 2026, cutting power to tens of thousands amid a night of strikes across Dnipropetrovsk, Kherson, and Kharkiv regions

label: Kharkiv Saltivka — High-Rise Strike
sub: A Russian strike collapsed floors 7-10 of a residential high-rise in Kharkiv's Saltivka district on August 9, 2026, killing 2 and injuring 20+

label: Zaporizhstal — Steel Plant Strike
sub: North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles struck the Zaporizhstal metallurgical plant on August 11, 2026, killing 6-7 workers — Russia said the plant supplied armor steel to Ukraine's military

label: Novorossiysk — Naval Base Strike
sub: Ukraine's largest strike yet on Russia's Black Sea Fleet base at Novorossiysk on August 12, 2026 damaged four warships and halted two grain export terminals

label: Berezivka, Odesa Oblast — Passenger Train Strike
sub: A jet-powered Russian Shahed drone struck the locomotive of a passenger train near Berezivka on August 13, 2026, killing 2 railway workers; 340 passengers evacuated safely

label: Ust-Luga — Oil Port Strike
sub: Ukrainian drones hit the Novatek-Ust-Luga gas processing complex on August 14, 2026 — the 6th strike on the Baltic port this year, damaging 2 processing units

label: Buryn, Sumy Oblast — Home Strike
sub: A Russian double drone strike destroyed a private home in Buryn on August 14, 2026, killing a mother and her 9-year-old son

label: Marhanets — High-Rise Strike
sub: A Russian drone strike on a Marhanets apartment building on August 15, 2026 killed a 3-month-old infant and injured 11 people

label: Kryvyi Rih — ArcelorMittal Plant Strike
sub: A Russian combined strike on Kryvyi Rih hit the ArcelorMittal steel plant on August 16, 2026, killing 2 and injuring 13, part of a wider barrage that killed 7 and injured 51

label: Moscow — Ukrainian Drone Assault
sub: Ukraine launched roughly 600 drones at Moscow on August 16, 2026, one of the largest single strikes on the Russian capital of the war

label: Galați, Romania — NATO Drone Shootdown
sub: A Spanish NATO F-18 shot down a Russian drone that crossed into Romanian airspace near Galați on August 16, 2026 — the 4th such incident in 2026

label: Novokairy, Kherson Oblast — Drone Strike
sub: A Russian drone strike on Novokairy village on August 17, 2026 killed two men aged 67 and 58

label: Koloskovo, Belgorod Oblast — Ukrainian Strike
sub: A Ukrainian missile and drone strike on Koloskovo village, Russia, on August 17, 2026 killed 6 and injured 4

label: Pechenihy, Kharkiv Oblast — Cruise Missile Strike
sub: Two Russian Banderol cruise missiles hit a post office and shops in Pechenihy on August 18, 2026, killing 10 and injuring 17

label: Izium — Tornado-S Rocket Strike
sub: A Russian Tornado-S rocket strike on Izium on August 18, 2026 injured 5, including a 9-year-old boy

label: Moscow — 620-Drone Assault
sub: Ukraine launched over 620 drones at Moscow on August 18, 2026, its largest drone strike on the capital in years, for a 2nd consecutive night of large-scale retaliation

label: Kherson — Minibus Drone Strike
sub: A Russian drone strike on a minibus in Kherson's Korabelnyi district on August 19, 2026 killed 4, with a separate strike later that day killing a 62-year-old woman (5 total)

label: Zhytomyr — Police HQ Drone Strike
sub: A Russian Banderol drone double-tap strike on Zhytomyr's National Police headquarters on August 19, 2026 killed 3 and injured 53

label: Zaporizhzhia — Market and Hostel Strike
sub: Russian drones struck Zaporizhzhia's central market and a nearby hostel on August 19, 2026, killing 1

label: Tula Oblast, Russia — Ukrainian Drone Strike
sub: Ukrainian long-range drones reportedly targeted Russia's 53rd Arsenal and the Novomoskovsk area of Tula Oblast on August 19, 2026

label: Kyiv — Massive Missile and Drone Attack
sub: Russia launched a massive combined missile-and-drone attack on Kyiv on August 20, 2026, killing 15 and damaging a children's hospital, kindergarten, and residential buildings across 28 locations

label: Kryvyi Rih — Shopping Mall Double-Tap Strike
sub: A Russian double-tap drone strike on the 'Sunny Gallery' shopping center in Kryvyi Rih killed 16+ and injured 130 on August 21, 2026

label: Tokarivka, Mykolaiv Oblast — Drone Strike Kills 4
sub: A Russian loitering munition killed 4 people, including 3 children, in Tokarivka on August 21, 2026

label: Tabaki Border Crossing — Drone Strike Closes Moldova Checkpoint
sub: A Russian drone strike damaged the Tabaki border crossing with Moldova on August 21, 2026, forcing its closure — the second consecutive night a Ukraine-Moldova crossing was hit

label: Kyiv (Darnytskyi) — Warehouse Fire from Ballistic Missile Strike
sub: A Russian ballistic missile strike set a warehouse ablaze in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district around 01:00 on August 22, 2026, killing 1

label: Zaporizhzhia — Minibus and Regional Drone Strikes
sub: A Russian drone struck a route minibus in Zaporizhzhia city and hit wider areas of the region on August 22, 2026, killing 4 and wounding 15

label: Izium — Guided Bomb Strike
sub: Three guided aerial bombs damage ~20 houses, injure 2

label: Kharkiv (Osnovianskyi) — Jet-Powered Shahed Strike
sub: 8 injured, incl. a 15-year-old; homes set ablaze

label: Kyiv — Ukraine-Norway Drone Deal Signed
sub: Zelensky and PM Støre sign Drone Deal + 'Elizabeth' strategic partnership agreement

label: Odesa — Epicentr Hypermarkets & Warehouses Struck
sub: 5 injured; 2 hypermarkets and food/energy infrastructure ablaze

label: Kyiv — Ukraine's 35th Independence Day
sub: European leaders incl. UK PM Burnham, EU's Costa join Zelensky for anniversary

label: Slavutych/Chernihiv — Power Facility Struck
sub: Russian strike cuts power to 30,000+ subscribers; part of a 5-oblast overnight barrage

label: Kharkiv & Zaporizhzhia — Geran-3 Drone Strikes
sub: 11 injured combined; houses, vehicles, and an industrial facility damaged

label: Afipsky Refinery, Krasnodar Krai — Struck by Ukrainian Drones
sub: 2 killed, 2 injured; major fire; Novoshakhtinsk (Rostov) and Astrakhan facilities also hit

label: Kyiv — Pauses Strikes on Moscow, St. Petersburg for CIA Visit
sub: Ukraine agrees to a temporary Aug 24–26 pause during CIA Director Ratcliffe's unannounced Moscow trip

label: Tambov, Lipetsk, Belgorod — 16-Target Drone Campaign
sub: Wildberries warehouse in Kotovsk destroyed; 3 killed in Lipetsk and Belgorod oblasts; NORSI refinery also hit

label: Kyiv — Massive 9-City Barrage
sub: Russia bombarded 9 Ukrainian cities overnight into August 27, 2026 with ballistic missiles, Onyx anti-ship missiles, and ~258 drones; 2 killed nationwide, 14+ wounded, sports complex and medical facility hit in Kyiv

label: Donetsk — Command Posts Struck
sub: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck Russia's main and reserve command posts near occupied Donetsk with air-launched cruise missiles, Aug 26 into Aug 27, 2026
